system.description: Filling a chalice with three of your own Blood Traits and intoning the rite, you cause the vitae to mystically transform into that of the Council of Seven once your subject — almost always a newly Embraced Tremere — drinks it entirely. This forges one step toward a blood bond to the whole council without ever risking the councilors' own vitae, and it is considered a requirement for full, recognized membership in Clan Tremere. It cannot be performed on vampires of the 14th or 15th generation, ghouls, or revenants.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
